rationale: Review round 1 (Codex, B1-B5): text output cannot prove a test ran, and rerunning every check with -json would change how each runs; the rule reads Go's own result lines in their exact form, flags as Go reads them, and leaves modes whose success says nothing about tests unjudged.
author: @claude

rationale: Review round 2 (Codex, R2-B1, R2-B2): the rule judges a plain argument grammar with known flags and their values; anything else is left unjudged, since reading it wrong would fail a good check.
author: @claude

rationale: Review round 3 (Codex, R3-B1..B3): the grammar shrinks to a short list of flags as Go registers them, with packages first; any other form keeps Go's outcome.
